title: Abnormal vibration on conveyor drive
problem: Conveyor vibration exceeds normal operating condition
solution: Check mounting bolts and bearing condition; record vibration reading before restart

title: Paint surface contamination
problem: Small foreign particles appear on painted surface
solution: Inspect booth cleanliness and filter condition; isolate affected batch for quality review

title: Sensor calibration after replacement
problem: Workstation sensor readings fluctuate after replacement
solution: Perform calibration using the approved standard procedure and verify against reference gauge

title: Repeated torque tool alarm
problem: Torque tool generates repeated tightening alarms
solution: Verify tool program and socket condition; escalate if torque trace remains outside specification
